value.rationale: It supplies an explicit unconditional constant-factor strengthening of the general diameter-two pebbling bound (16r+8 down to 4r) for a structural graph class characterized by a universal vertex and perfect matching in the remainder. The proof gives an implementable parity-repair algorithm valid on an infinite graph family and all its edge supergraphs. It does not claim an unproved exact classification or general lower sharpness.
